'''Liintaar Station''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] communication base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was [[Assault on Liintaar|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the war.
